instructions.vi: Người có thẩm quyền điền submission fields, lưu artifact dưới artifacts/, tính SHA-256 rồi chạy operations:evidence:intake. Không sửa kit để tự phê duyệt và không gửi secret.
instructions.en: An authorised owner fills the submission fields, stores the artifact under artifacts/, computes SHA-256, then runs operations:evidence:intake. Do not self-approve or submit secrets.

requiredFields.description: Named person or organisation responsible for this gate.
Role and scope that authorise the evidence.
Repository-relative path under artifacts/; never a URL with a secret.
Exact SHA-256 of the submitted artifact.
Optional context; never include passwords, API keys or tokens.
